surface: Playground reference adapters: input, card, kinetic headline, profile hero, chat message, line chart, violin chart — plus the panel vocabulary of the Button adapter, which had no rendering

merge.how: The Lead runs `node apps/showcase/scripts/i18n-merge.mjs --write` once; this file is the handoff.
merge.note: Labels, help text, stage notes, unsupported reasons and option labels are all rendered through `tcs` (controls/index.tsx wraps the label/help/option label; shell.tsx already wraps stageNote and reason). Keys already in the dictionary are skipped by the merge, so the pre-existing renderings for Invalid, Disabled, Read-only, Leading icon, Links, Stagger, Spinner, Full width, Tactile press, Close, Title, Size, State (Status) and Tooltip stay as they are.

sentences.en: Control density, not emphasis: a toolbar wants `sm`, a form wants `md`.
sentences.zh: 控制的是密度，不是强调：工具栏用 `sm`，表单用 `md`。

sentences.en: A hint, never a name — it disappears the moment the reader types.
sentences.zh: 只是提示，不是名称——读者一开始输入它就消失了。

sentences.en: The attribute a screen reader actually reads. Every field needs one.
sentences.zh: 读屏软件真正读到的是这个属性。每个字段都需要它。

sentences.en: Still selectable and still focusable; a dashed hairline, never dimmed.
sentences.zh: 依然可选、依然可聚焦；用虚线细边表达，绝不靠降低不透明度。

sentences.en: Your own icon element in a product; the copied code uses a dependency-free stand-in.
sentences.zh: 在产品里这里放你自己的图标元素；复制出的代码用一个不依赖任何图标库的替身。

sentences.en: Sits inside the shell, after the value.
sentences.zh: 位于输入框外壳内部、数值之后。

sentences.en: A real text field: type in it. Focus, hover, invalid and read-only are the same shell you would ship.
sentences.zh: 一个真实的文本输入框：可以直接输入。聚焦、悬停、无效与只读用的就是你会上线的同一个外壳。

sentences.en: A controlled field is your form's state; the preview renders an uncontrolled field you can type into.
sentences.zh: 受控字段属于你的表单状态；这里渲染的是一个可以直接输入的非受控字段。

sentences.en: An initial value belongs to the field's own state — leave it empty here so the placeholder is visible.
sentences.zh: 初始值属于字段自身的状态——这里留空，才能看到占位提示。

sentences.en: A callback is your application's behaviour, not a previewable value.
sentences.zh: 回调是你应用的行为，不是一个能预览的值。

sentences.en: `email`, `number` and `date` change the editing model and the keyboard, not the look.
sentences.zh: `email`、`number` 与 `date` 改变的是编辑模型与键盘行为，不是外观。

sentences.en: Layout and width belong to the page that places the field. `inputClassName` styles the inner element the same way.
sentences.zh: 布局与宽度属于放置这个字段的页面。`inputClassName` 同理，作用于内部元素。

sentences.en: Trailing action
sentences.zh: 尾部操作

sentences.en: At sign
sentences.zh: at 符号

sentences.en: Shortcut
sentences.zh: 快捷键

sentences.en: Variant
sentences.zh: 变体

sentences.en: Padding
sentences.zh: 内边距

sentences.en: Interaction
sentences.zh: 交互

sentences.en: Element
sentences.zh: 元素

sentences.en: Depth in the surface stack. `raised` is a higher plane, `ghost` is grouping with no chrome.
sentences.zh: 在表面层级中的深度。`raised` 是更高一层，`ghost` 只做分组、不画外框。

sentences.en: `none` lets the parts set the rhythm; the others pad the shell as well.
sentences.zh: `none` 让各部件自己决定节奏；其余取值会再给外壳加一层内边距。

sentences.en: The intent, not a bool: `featured` is the loudest static mode. Tilt and spotlight live in the motion primitives that wrap a Card.
sentences.zh: 表达的是意图，不是一个布尔值：`featured` 是最有存在感的静态模式。倾斜与聚光属于包裹 Card 的动效原语。

sentences.en: Reads as selected; it means something when the interaction is `selectable`.
sentences.zh: 呈现为选中态；当交互为 `selectable` 时它才有实际含义。

sentences.en: A container's element should match what it holds.
sentences.zh: 容器用什么元素，要由它装的内容决定。

sentences.en: The real surface stack: a hairline and a luminance step, with the parts carrying their own padding.
sentences.zh: 真实的表面层级：一道细线与一级明度差，各部件自带内边距。

sentences.en: The V1.1 boolean, superseded by `interaction` — which says what the card is for.
sentences.zh: V1.1 的布尔属性，已被 `interaction` 取代——后者直接说明这张卡片的用途。

sentences.en: Only meaningful when the card renders as an anchor, which this preview does not.
sentences.zh: 只有当卡片渲染为链接时才有意义，而这里的预览并非链接。

sentences.en: Width, grid placement and page-level overrides belong to the page.
sentences.zh: 宽度、网格位置与页面级覆盖都属于页面。

sentences.en: Headline
sentences.zh: 标题文案

sentences.en: Live region
sentences.zh: 实时区域

sentences.en: The component animates a change to this string — it is the headline's only content.
sentences.zh: 组件会为这个字符串的变化做动效——它就是标题的全部内容。

sentences.en: `reveal` assembles the words; `swap` replaces the line in place.
sentences.zh: `reveal` 让词语逐个就位；`swap` 在原位整句替换。

sentences.en: Seconds between consecutive words.
sentences.zh: 相邻两个词之间的秒数。

sentences.en: The caller owns the type scale, so the tag is a choice rather than a default.
sentences.zh: 字号体系由调用方决定，所以标签是选择，而不是默认值。

sentences.en: Announce the new text politely when it changes, for a status line rather than a headline.
sentences.zh: 文本变化时礼貌播报，适合状态行而不是大标题。

sentences.en: Edit the headline: the words re-enter with the mode and the stagger you chose.
sentences.zh: 改一改标题：词语会按你选的模式与错峰间隔重新进场。

sentences.en: Type scale and layout belong to the page that places the headline.
sentences.zh: 字号体系与布局属于放置这个标题的页面。

sentences.en: Colour and spacing come from the type tokens; an inline style would override the system.
sentences.zh: 颜色与间距来自字体 token；内联样式会绕开这套系统。

sentences.en: Name
sentences.zh: 姓名

sentences.en: Eyebrow
sentences.zh: 眉标

sentences.en: Lead
sentences.zh: 引导段

sentences.en: Alignment
sentences.zh: 对齐

sentences.en: Facts
sentences.zh: 事实栏

sentences.en: Portrait
sentences.zh: 头像位

sentences.en: Rendered as the page `h1`.
sentences.zh: 渲染为页面的 `h1`。

sentences.en: One paragraph of orientation; keep it to two sentences.
sentences.zh: 一段用来定位的说明，控制在两句以内。

sentences.en: `editorial` sets the name at display scale; `instrument` keeps a technical scale.
sentences.zh: `editorial` 用展示级字号写名字；`instrument` 保持技术型字号。

sentences.en: A definition list, not prose: location, since, focus.
sentences.zh: 是定义列表，不是段落：地点、起始时间、方向。

sentences.en: Each link carries a handle, and the list has its own accessible name.
sentences.zh: 每条链接都带账号名，整个列表有自己的无障碍名称。

sentences.en: Your own image or element; the stand-in here is an Avatar with initials.
sentences.zh: 这里放你自己的图片或元素；此处的替身是带首字母的 Avatar。

sentences.en: One assembly, two design axes: the name stays the page `h1` whichever variant you pick.
sentences.zh: 同一套装配、两个设计轴：无论选哪个变体，名字始终是页面的 `h1`。

sentences.en: Two facts
sentences.zh: 两条事实

sentences.en: Two links
sentences.zh: 两条链接

sentences.en: Monogram
sentences.zh: 首字母标记

sentences.en: The primary action needs a destination and a handler — your page's, not the preview's.
sentences.zh: 主要操作需要目标地址与回调——那属于你的页面，不属于预览。

sentences.en: Width and placement belong to the page that mounts the hero.
sentences.zh: 宽度与摆放位置属于挂载这个头图的页面。

sentences.en: Sender
sentences.zh: 发送方

sentences.en: Author
sentences.zh: 显示名

sentences.en: Message
sentences.zh: 消息正文

sentences.en: Timestamp
sentences.zh: 时间戳

sentences.en: Avatar
sentences.zh: 头像

sentences.en: Who the turn came from. It is `from`, not `role`, so a consumer's jsx-a11y lint stays clean.
sentences.zh: 这一轮来自谁。prop 名是 `from` 而不是 `role`，这样使用方的 jsx-a11y 检查不会误报。

sentences.en: A display name. Empty keeps the component's own word for the role.
sentences.zh: 显示名。留空则使用组件自带的角色称呼。

sentences.en: `pending` recedes, `error` takes the negative surface, `streaming` marks an unfinished turn.
sentences.zh: `pending` 后退一层，`error` 换成负向表面，`streaming` 表示这一轮还没说完。

sentences.en: Pre-formatted by you: a relative time is a product decision, and the component never guesses one.
sentences.zh: 时间由你格式化：相对时间属于产品决策，组件从不替你猜。

sentences.en: Replaces the role glyph; the accessible name still comes from the author.
sentences.zh: 替换角色图形；无障碍名称仍然来自显示名。

sentences.en: A real turn: the body wraps, the timestamp is text you supply, and the status changes the surface.
sentences.zh: 真实的一轮对话：正文会换行，时间戳是你传入的文本，状态会改变表面。

sentences.en: Role glyph
sentences.zh: 角色图形

sentences.en: Dot
sentences.zh: 圆点

sentences.en: Copy, regenerate and rate need your callbacks, and they are revealed on hover.
sentences.zh: 复制、重写与评分需要你的回调，而且它们在悬停时才出现。

sentences.en: Sources, tool calls and attachments are your data, rendered under the body.
sentences.zh: 引用来源、工具调用与附件都是你的数据，渲染在正文下方。

sentences.en: Width and placement belong to the conversation layout that mounts the message.
sentences.zh: 宽度与摆放位置属于挂载这条消息的会话布局。

sentences.en: Legend
sentences.zh: 图例

sentences.en: Visible series
sentences.zh: 可见系列

sentences.en: Animation
sentences.zh: 动效

sentences.en: Accessible name
sentences.zh: 无障碍名称

sentences.en: Value format
sentences.zh: 数值格式

sentences.en: State
sentences.zh: 状态

sentences.en: Trend
sentences.zh: 趋势

sentences.en: None
sentences.zh: 无

sentences.en: Also the chart's accessible name when no `ariaLabel` is given.
sentences.zh: 没有传 `ariaLabel` 时，它同时也是图表的无障碍名称。

sentences.en: The legend is also the series switch; it needs two or more comparable series.
sentences.zh: 图例同时是系列开关；需要两条及以上可比较的系列。

sentences.en: Start with a series hidden rather than removing it from the data.
sentences.zh: 让某条系列一开始就隐藏，而不是把它从数据里删掉。

sentences.en: Loading, empty and error are drawn by the chart chrome, not by your page.
sentences.zh: 加载中、空数据与错误由图表外壳绘制，不需要你的页面来做。

sentences.en: `axis` reads the whole column; `item` reads one mark.
sentences.zh: `axis` 读取整列数据；`item` 只读单个图形。

sentences.en: Leave it empty and the chart names itself from the title and the family.
sentences.zh: 留空时，图表会用标题与所属家族自己命名。

sentences.en: A fixed twelve-session fixture. Every value is the caller's, and the chart computes nothing.
sentences.zh: 固定的十二个交易日示例。每个值都由调用方提供，图表不做任何计算。

sentences.en: Presentation only: the chart formats what it is given and never converts a unit.
sentences.zh: 只影响呈现：图表格式化传给它的值，从不做单位换算。

sentences.en: The outline is supplied, never fitted: this fixture is the caller's own density estimate.
sentences.zh: 轮廓是传进来的，从不拟合：这份示例就是调用方自己的密度估计。

sentences.en: A whole dataset is the caller's, never a control. The preview draws a fixed fixture and the copied code writes it out in full.
sentences.zh: 整个数据集属于调用方，永远不是一个控件。预览使用固定示例，复制出的代码会完整写出这份数据。

sentences.en: The fixture is keyed by `date`; a real chart's key follows the shape your API serves.
sentences.zh: 示例数据以 `date` 为键；真实图表用哪个键，取决于你 API 返回的形状。

sentences.en: Series mark types, axes and stacking are the analytical contract, described above this panel.
sentences.zh: 系列的图形类型、轴与堆叠属于分析契约，见本面板上方的说明。

sentences.en: The density outline is the caller's model output; the preview supplies a fixed outline and the copied code writes it out.
sentences.zh: 密度轮廓是调用方的模型输出；预览提供固定轮廓，复制出的代码会把它写出来。

sentences.en: Layout and width belong to the page that places the chart.
sentences.zh: 布局与宽度属于放置图表的页面。

sentences.en: Intent, not importance. `primary` is the one action a view is about.
sentences.zh: 表达意图，而不是重要程度。`primary` 是一个视图真正要促成的那个动作。

sentences.en: Keeps the width, stays focusable and reports `aria-busy`. It is not `disabled`.
sentences.zh: 保持宽度、仍可聚焦，并声明 `aria-busy`。它不等于 `disabled`。

sentences.en: In your product this is your own icon element; the generated code uses a dependency-free stand-in.
sentences.zh: 在你的产品里这里放你自己的图标元素；生成的代码用一个不依赖任何图标库的替身。

sentences.en: The real component, including press ink and the pointer light.
sentences.zh: 真实组件：包括按压墨迹与指针光。

sentences.en: `submit`, `reset` and `button` only mean something inside a real form.
sentences.zh: `submit`、`reset` 与 `button` 只有在真实表单里才有意义。

sentences.en: Renders a different element entirely; the sample would need your node.
sentences.zh: 会渲染成完全不同的元素；示例需要你提供那个节点。

sentences.en: Label
sentences.zh: 文案

sentences.zh: 箭头
